title: High Fire Glazing and Reduction Kiln Firing
source_quote: High Fire Glazing and Reduction Kiln Firing... Friday, 10/16/26 from 6-10pm, Saturday, 10/24/26/26 from 5-8pm
evidence_sentence: Students glaze pots and fire an updraft kiln in the reduction firing process at 2,350°-2,370° Fahrenheit.
evidence_quote: We will glaze the pots, load them, and fire an updraft kiln in the reduction firing process between 2,350°-70° Fahrenheit.
summary: A short workshop on October 16–24 for firing glazed pots in a reduction kiln. Students bring bisque pots, glaze them, load and fire the kiln, and unload together. Includes instruction on glazes and formulas. Cost is $3.50/pound.
bring: bisque stoneware or porcelain pots (Cone 10 only)
